summary.title: Mochary Method Curriculum
summary.one_liner: A Google Docs curriculum by Matt Mochary for learning the Mochary Method of people management, with reading sub-docs and written reflection questions.
takeaways: The page is a Google Doc curriculum for the Mochary Method, a people management approach by Matt Mochary.
The curriculum is worked through by reading sub-docs and writing answers to reflection questions in the main doc.
Users are invited to make their own copy of the curriculum.
The page text does not show the specific lessons or method details, so those are unknown from this page alone.
